command:
set -eu
R=/workspace/omega_runtime/imports/research_fresh
test -z "$(git -C "$R" status --porcelain)"
git -C "$R" merge --ff-only origin/main
printf 'RESEARCH_SOURCE_HEAD='; git -C "$R" rev-parse HEAD
cd /workspace/omega_runtime/extensions/ingress_v3
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m omega.research_ingest ingest --root "$R" --db /workspace/omega_runtime/data/omega_unified.db
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
p='file:/workspace/omega_runtime/data/omega_unified.db?mode=ro'
c=sqlite3.connect(p,uri=True,timeout=10)
print('INTEGRITY',c.execute('pragma quick_check(1)').fetchone()[0])
print('RESEARCH_TOTAL',c.execute('select count(*) from research_artifact').fetchone()[0])
print('FTS_TOTAL',c.execute('select count(*) from research_artifact_fts').fetchone()[0])
for row in c.execute('select source_commit,count(*) from research_artifact group by source_commit order by count(*) desc limit 4'):
 print('COMMIT_ROWS',row)
c.close()
PY
